name: Trade Secret Protection and Non-Use
text: The Receiving Party acknowledges that the Disclosing Party's trade secrets, including formulae, processes, methods, designs, customer and supplier data, pricing models, and proprietary know-how, derive independent economic value from not being generally known and are subject to reasonable efforts to maintain their secrecy. The Receiving Party shall not, during the term of this Agreement or at any time thereafter, use, exploit, or disclose any such trade secret for its own benefit or for the benefit of any third party. Any improvement, derivative, or insight derived by the Receiving Party from the trade secrets shall belong to the Disclosing Party. The Receiving Party shall be liable to account for any gains made through the misuse of trade secrets, in addition to any other remedy available in law or equity.

legal_basis.note: Confidentiality protecting trade secrets is a recognised exception to restraint of trade
Compensation for loss or damage caused by breach of contract

invalid_if: Information does not qualify as a trade secret
Information is lawfully in the public domain
title: Trade Secret Protection
